123:     def trojan_attack(self, positive_prompts, negative_prompts, normal_hidden_states, layer_idx):
124:         '''
125:         Create steer vector, from positive_prompts to negative_prompts
126:         '''
127:         from sv.pca import PCAModel
128:         pca = PCAModel(self.model, self.tokenizer)
129:         pos_hidden_states = pca.create_hidden_states(positive_prompts)
130:         neg_hidden_states = pca.create_hidden_states(negative_prompts)
131:         pos_center = torch.mean(pos_hidden_states, axis = 1)
132:         neg_center = torch.mean(neg_hidden_states, axis = 1)
133:         steer_center = neg_center - pos_center
134:         steer_center[layer_idx] = self.normalize_delta_to_preserve_stats(normal_hidden_states, steer_center[layer_idx])

137:     def normalize_delta_to_preserve_stats(self, reference, delta):
138:         """
139:         Normalize each row in delta to have the same mean and std as the corresponding row in reference.
140: 
141:         Args:
142:             reference: Tensor of shape (num_samples, hidden_dim)
143:             delta: Tensor of shape (num_samples, hidden_dim)
144: 
145:         Returns:
146:             norm_delta: Tensor of shape (num_samples, hidden_dim)
147:         """
148:         mean_r = reference.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
149:         std_r = reference.std(dim=1, keepdim=True)
150: 
151:         mean_d = delta.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
152:         std_d = delta.std(dim=1, keepdim=True)
153: 
154:         norm_delta = (delta - mean_d) / (std_d + 1e-6) * std_r + mean_r
155:         return norm_delta
